content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Breach
content_blocks.text: The Tenant is hereby notified that it has failed to comply with the terms of the Lease Agreement by failing to maintain the Premises in good repair and condition.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Time_for_Cure
content_blocks.text: The Tenant has thirty (30) days from the date of this Notice to cure the breach or vacate the Premises without penalty.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Legal_Action
content_blocks.text: If the Tenant fails to cure the breach within the specified time period, the Landlord reserves the right to commence legal action for immediate possession of the Premises.
